info.description: Lumen support tickets in the v2 shape, one per line, with a gold category and urgency and a dev/test split.
info.migration: From tickets.v1: priority is renamed urgency (same four values), and category gains the value security, which no ticket uses yet. Run data/python/migrate_tickets.py to write the v2 file from the v1 file. tickets.v1 stays, deprecated, until its sunset on 2027-01-31.

fields.meaning: the ticket's stable key, t001 to t060; consumers look tickets up by it
fields.name: id

fields.meaning: the gold label a classifier is scored against; security is new in v2
fields.name: category

fields.meaning: the gold urgency of the ticket (v1 called it priority)
fields.name: urgency

fields.meaning: free-form labels, often empty (the contract checks the array, not its items)
fields.name: tags

fields.meaning: dev tickets tune prompts, test tickets score them; never mixed
fields.name: split
